environment: Windows Sandbox with networking enabled, run as SYSTEM, Edge confirmed by the operator
scope: F2 slice 1: local DNS resolver through a service-owned NRPT rule, wildcard and allow rules, HTTPS block page

package.build: tools/build-msi-fixtures.ps1 -Production (no defines), WiX 5.0.2, version 0.3.0, agent and installer source at 48bef1c
package.fault_injection_actions: absent (CustomAction table checked inside Sandbox before install)

checks: production install with DNSFILTER routes system DNS through the managed NRPT rule
wildcard blocks apex and subdomains while allowed and unlisted names resolve upstream
trusted HTTPS block page for a wildcard subdomain
Edge shows the block page for a wildcard subdomain, confirmed by the operator
killed process keeps the NRPT rule and service recovery restores resolution
policy change applies to DNS without restarting the service
graceful stop removes the rule and start restores it
removal restores NRPT rules, trust and hosts
notes: System resolution was checked with Resolve-DnsName without -Server, so answers came through the NRPT rule

Earlier attempts: the first failed because the Sandbox DNS proxy resolves through the host, whose own openems agent blocks example.com (fixtures moved to iana.org with a preflight); the second exposed that the service did not report StopPending while removing the rule, which made Stop-Service fail (fixed in 48bef1c)
Each install waits about 2 minutes on Windows Installer signature checks of the unsigned package
not_validated: Physical endpoint, VPN clients with their own NRPT rules and captive portals
Real management server end-to-end policy changes
DNS over HTTPS configured in browsers and other bypasses (F2 slice 3)
